insurer: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (schedule-based; options include ₹8L, ₹10L, ₹12L, ₹15L referenced)

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day. Proportionate deduction applies on associate medical expenses if higher room opted.

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day.

copayment.note: 20% co-payment applies when insured is treated in a hospital outside their designated zone (Zone I/II/III). No co-pay for in-zone treatment.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, modern treatments, ARMD, mental illness, genetic disorders capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of SI or ₹50k (whichever less); Robotic surgery: 50% SI up to ₹2L; Oral chemo: 10% SI up to ₹50k; ARMD: 10% SI up to ₹75k; Mental illness: 25% SI; Genetic disorders: 25% SI; Puberty/menopause: 25% SI; Artificial life support: 10% SI/15 days; Hospital cash reduces SI.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 36 months from first policy inception. Reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for cataract, hernia, hydrocele, stones, varicose veins, benign tumours etc. Some conditions (congenital external, joint replacement, ARMD, mental illness, genetic disorders) have 36-month wait. Diabetes, hypertension, cardiac conditions have 90-day wait.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Policy references 'Claim Free Year' definition but no cumulative/no-claim bonus benefit is described in the wording.

restoration.note: No restoration or reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day care covered for procedures listed in Annexure I (226 procedures listed).

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is explicitly excluded under specific exclusion 4.4.17.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year.

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation expenses of organ donor covered (excluding cost of organ), subject to recipient's Sum Insured.

ambulance.note: Ambulance charges covered up to 1% of Sum Insured per insured event for emergency/ICU admission or inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered with individual sub-limits: e.g. robotic surgery up to 50% SI/₹2L, oral chemo 10% SI/₹50k, intravitreal injections 10% SI/₹30k, etc.

consumables.note: Consumables like gloves, masks, etc. are listed under non-payable items (Annexure II List I). No rider available.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment in India only. Treatment outside India is excluded (clause 4.4.27 and 5.18).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes. No coverage during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period from date of receipt of policy document for new policies of 1 year or more.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, out-of-India treatment, acupressure/acupuncture, external prosthetics/hearing aids, OPD procedures converted to IP, vaccination

optional_riders.display: Optional Cover I: Enhanced cataract limit (SI ₹8L+, benefit after 36 months)

source_file: New India Asha kiran policy clause.pdf
